title: WinUICompat launch crash fix: fail-soft theme resource resolver

summary.behavior: All direct Application.Current.Resources[key] indexer lookups in the compatibility-preview code-behind are replaced by a fail-soft TryGetValue-based ResolveThemeResource<T> helper that returns null on a miss, so missing framework theme resources can no longer throw KeyNotFoundException during window activation and surface as fail-fast 0xC000027B in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll.
summary.diagnosis: Issue #548 body: launch bisect pinned the regression to 1875e18 (PR #450); faulting module Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll 3.1.7.0 offset 0x39ce55; DesktopCompat unaffected; offline patch validation isolated the indexer lookups as the cause with the Mica backdrop line innocent.
summary.false_close_note: PR #564 (6684a11) closed this issue without touching the file (its diff was accidentally committed .opencode state, removed separately via Issue #568). This delivery contains the actual fix.

validation.notes: launch smoke passed on the delivered tree; crashed reproducibly before the fix
run on delivered branch before push

scope: winui-shell compatibility code-behind only; formal XAML path and DesktopCompat behavior unchanged
